author: KEXP
description:
Under the musical project Jay Som, LA-based artist Melina Duterte offers an addictive mix of hazy dream pop and lively indie rock on her latest release 'Belong'. In the KEXP Live Room, she shares an intimate performance of "Appointments" and more. 

Watch the full in-studio session on our YouTube channel and catch Jay Som perform at Vinelands Live on Saturday, February 28 at Gray Area. Tickets available on our website.
title: Jay Som performs "Appointments" and more Live on KEXP
